en.bdb: The Gurmukhs always accept the divine order
Spending this life fruitfully the Gurmukh goes to the other world.

verses.gurmukhi: ਸਚੀ ਦਰਗਹ ਜਾਇ ਸਚਾ ਪਿੜ ਮਲਿਆ।
verses.translit_en: sachee dharageh jai sachaa piR maliaa|

en.bdb: There in the true court (of the lord) they get their true place.
Repast of the Gurmukh is love and their delight is devoid of flirtatiousness.

verses.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਨਿਹਚਲੁ ਚਿਤੁ ਨ ਹਲੈ ਹਲਿਆ।
verses.translit_en: gurmukh nihachal chit na halai haliaa|

en.bdb: The Gurmukh has a tranquil heart and remains steadfast even in ups and downs.

verses.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸਚੁ ਅਲਾਉ ਭਲੀ ਹੂੰ ਭਲਿਆ।
verses.translit_en: gurmukh sach alaau bhalee hoo(n) bhaliaa|

en.bdb: The Gurmukh speaks truth and good of the good.
Only Gurmukhs are called to the court of the Lord and they come to the world only when the Lord sends them.
